repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Agent never transitioned from reconnaissance to exploitation, repeatedly exhausting allowance without engaging target services

skill_cards.if_condition: When target network responses contain open TCP/UDP ports above 1024 after initial scan
skill_cards.then_action: Launch targeted service enumeration with nmap --top-ports 100 -sV

skill_cards.if_condition: When banner grabbing reveals outdated HTTP or FTP service versions
skill_cards.then_action: Execute service-specific exploit candidates via searchsploit matched to detected version

skill_cards.if_condition: When host enumeration results include legitimate admin credentials or credentials leakage clues
skill_cards.then_action: Attempt credential-based persistence via sshpass/pscp tests using extracted credentials
